name: tandem
description: A personal kanban board over GitHub issues for steering agentic coding.

scripts.build: vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && node scripts/write-version.mjs
scripts.build:demo: vite build -c vite.demo.config.ts && cp src/demo/vercel.json dist/demo/vercel.json && cp dist/demo/index.html dist/demo/404.html
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.server.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.demo.json
scripts.verify: npm run check:selectors && npm run check:e2e-reset && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run e2e
scripts.check:e2e-reset: ! grep -rlE --include='*.ts' '@playwright/test' e2e --exclude=fixtures.ts || (echo 'a spec imports @playwright/test: import test and expect from ./fixtures.ts, which resets the fixture server before every test (CLAUDE.md)' && false)
scripts.check:selectors: ! grep -rnE 'useStore\(.*\?\? *(\[\]|\{\})' src/web || (echo 'zustand selector returns a fresh literal: use a module constant (CLAUDE.md)' && false)
